title: Only a reviewed pull request, from main's workflow, can apply a migration to production
detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: fork pull requests are refused correctly, but workflow_dispatch runs the workflow file from the ref the dispatcher picks, so a branch with an edited apply-migration.yml, or any workflow on any branch that declares environment production-db, gets SUPABASE_DB_URL unless the environment restricts deployment branches. The SETUP comment mentions only adding the secret and calls the required reviewer optional. The workflow never checks that the PR was approved, and its green gate trusts check-run names (db-tests, test, lint) a PR branch can create. The environment's settings could not be read from the scan (the environments API is blocked by the proxy). THE FIX: require 'Deployment branches: main only' and a required reviewer on production-db in SETUP and docs/DATABASE.md (an owner setting), add a step that fails unless github.ref is refs/heads/main, require an APPROVED review from someone other than the author, and match required checks by the GitHub Actions app id.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!/github\.ref != 'refs\/heads\/main'|github\.ref == 'refs\/heads\/main'/.test(r('.github/workflows/apply-migration.yml'))){console.error('SCAN-847: the production migration workflow runs from any ref the dispatcher picks');process.exit(1)}"
